snippet.title: LumenKnight - New Trailer (Roguelike Survival)
snippet.description:
About this update: LumenKnight is back with a massive gameplay overhaul! I’ve updated the combat system, added new classes, and improved the perk system to give you more control over your builds.

Face endless waves of enemies, dodge deadly traps, and prepare yourself for the bosses waiting at the end of every run. How long can you survive the light?

Wishlist on Steam to support the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4135160/LumenKnight/
